The predicate BW = 0valid OR 1valid OR horn OR dualhorn OR bijunctive is CORRECT for single-relation bounded width: a 0/1-valid single relation has a CONSTANT polymorphism => its CSP is trivially satisfiable => genuinely bounded width. even-parity-4 (contains 0000/1111) is correctly bounded; odd-parity-4 (constant-free, majority-free, semilattice-free = PURELY affine) is correctly unbounded. Verified by enumeration; matches v1 I3/§2 ('smallest affine-unbounded witness is arity 4'). The flag applied the LANGUAGE-level 'affine=>unbounded' to single relations. NO predicate change.

the_dropped_localization_arm.what_dropped: predictions 3 (bounded-width<->parameterized survival, formerly 3b) and 4 (localization absorption, the I6 headline) are OUT OF THE SEAL.
the_dropped_localization_arm.why_provably_confounded: In the Boolean single-relation domain, unbounded-width-tractable = PURELY-AFFINE (Schaefer: the tractable classes are exactly horn/dual-horn/bijunctive/affine, and BW = tractable-minus-purely-affine). NP-hard relations are param-open (v1 marginal: 7 unbounded = 7 NPC = 7 param-open), so among PARAM-REAL rows the only unbounded-width relations are purely-affine (odd-parity-like), which are param-FPT (affine=>WS=>FPT). But the affine=>WS bridge NETS AFFINE OUT. Therefore: conditioning the BRIDGE-COMPLETED residual on bounded-width = conditioning on a CONSTANT (one stratum, UNTESTABLE, exactly v1's degeneracy relocated); conditioning the RAW residual on bounded-width = RE-DERIVING the affine netting (non-independent). Arity 4 removes v1's marginal degeneracy but replaces it with an affine CONFOUND. This is provable from theorems already on the table; measuring it would fail the program's 'do not measure what you can prove' standard.
the_dropped_localization_arm.owner_ruling: Option 1 (2026-07-23): drop 3 & 4 from the seal; pred 5 is the headline; preds 1 & 6 stay as gates; pred 2 demoted to a descriptive marginal.
the_dropped_localization_arm.sharpened_I6_statement_banked_not_specce: Localization absorption is UNASKABLE in the Boolean single-relation domain at ANY arity, because on the param-real/tractable rows unbounded-width = purely-affine, so BW-variation there IS the affine flag. The smallest well-posed home is domain >= 3 (Mal'tsev-but-not-bounded-width languages exist, so BW and affine separate), BUT the Sprint 3.5 flag that the domain-3 approximation charge may be thin/absent means that needs its own I-phase before commit. No domain-3 spec authorized (queue inflation).
